title: Render-mention test patterns: case-insensitive, narrower
lead: The sq-61 guard patterns in tests/squalify.Cli.Tests/DocsTests.cs (`RenderMentions`) are case-sensitive except `rendering steps`, so "Quire" or ".PDF" would pass, and `\.(pdf|html)\b` would flag any future legitimate .html link in README, CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS or release.md. Make them case-insensitive and decide what an allowed .html or .pdf mention is. Also: slice Check greps should use word boundaries (`quire` matches "require"), and `.gitattributes` still carries `*.pdf binary` (harmless; prune or keep).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Failing cases for "Quire" and ".PDF" and one allowed link; 2. adjust the patterns; 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
